name: SUSHI CON SALSA
location: 11 William E Mullins Way, Boston, MA 02118
description:
Ven a disfrutar de sushi rico y mueve el cuerpo con salsa en nuestras sesiones de baile en vivo, ¡no te lo pierdas!


Ready to move your body and enjoy an amazing vibe? Join our dance sessions where salsa reigns supreme and the fun never stops. Come share moves, laughter, and good vibes with people who love music as much as you do. It doesn't matter if you're a beginner or an expert, the important thing is to have a great time!

We'll warm up with a Latin dance lesson with Luis Talavera (@luis_td_bachata) and Claudia Leitzman (@ariaaperezzz) to let our bodies loosen up a little bit before a social dance session with DJ Lola Vera (@love.lolavera) where everybody is welcome on the dance floor!


There will also be a special menu filled with latin flavors with unique dishes and cocktails from our friends from Planteray Rum.

The ticket secures a spot in the class and a courtesy cocktail or mocktail at our bar!

Social hour after the class is FREE.


Source: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/sushi-con-salsa-dance-sessions-vol1-tickets-1988719477492
